headline: What keeps me choosing everyone but my soulmate?
note:
Soulmate age-band batch (2026-08-19), 25-44 WHY rung.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴🔴 THE HEADLINE PRESUPPOSES SHE CHOSE, AND THE VOC SAYS SHE OFTEN DID NOT. The theme pull (sm-choosing-wrong, 2026-08-19) came back as fraud and abuse: 'badly hurt by a man I thought loved me but he was a scammer', 'my marriage broke up because of domestic abuse and I'm scared of yet again choosing a wrong man', 'abusive, and divorced him', 'he turned out to be a convicted paedophile'. Telling a woman who was defrauded or assaulted that she keeps choosing wrong blames her for a crime committed against her.

So cut 3 REFUSES THE PREMISE, on every card. She did not choose them; she was shown something else — her own words: 'seemed to be one person but changed along the way'. 🔴 NOTHING about a pattern in her, low self-worth, attachment style, healing herself first, attracting what she is, or needing to fix anything before love arrives. 🔴 NO diagnosis of any kind. 🔴 Never name or convict a real man either — the read describes what was SHOWN, never rules on who he is.

🔴 NO DURATION, NO DATE, NO PROMISED ARRIVAL.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the sword on his table has a cross at the handle.
You asked what keeps you choosing everyone but your soulmate. Your hand went to the man with his tools laid out.
So you didn't choose them, dear. They showed you one man and turned into another.
And that table has four different things on it, dear. You got shown one.
But you had one thing to go on, dear. Anyone would have read it the same.
That's why it changed on you later, dear. You'd only ever seen the front.
Let me look closer at what gets shown first and what comes after…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — his shoes are gold, and they're the brightest thing he wears.
You asked what keeps you choosing everyone but your soulmate. Your hand went to the card that hangs the wrong way up.
So the fault was not in your choosing, dear. You were shown the wrong way up.
And the gold on this card sits at his feet, dear. Not at his head.
But you can only see what's turned toward you, dear. The rest stays round the back.
That's why they seemed right at the start, dear. The bright part faces out.
Let me look closer at what has been turned away from you each time…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the flowers on his coat are stitched, not picked.
You asked what keeps you choosing everyone but your soulmate. Your hand went to the one dressed for the road.
So you were not picking badly, dear. You were picking from what came near you.
And the flowers on that coat are stitched on, dear. Not one of them grew.
But from where you stood they looked real, dear. Anyone would think so.
That's why you believed them, dear. They were made to look that way.
Let me look closer at what was sewn on before you ever met…
